👮 **Wachiman** · review of the whole pull request, at `dac8318`: all 14 files reviewed.

5 finding(s): 4 to consider; 4 on their lines. Reply in a comment's thread to answer it.

### For your information

- ⚪📝 **Info · docs: The doc gets the destination count right; the PR body does not (confidence high)** (`apps/documentation/src/content/docs/backlog/prepare-screen.md:114`): This doc says the code has six destinations and that the panel lists `DESTINATION_IDS`. That is true: `destinations.ts:36-43` has youtube, vertical, square, github, chat and archive, and the test at library-detail-page.test.tsx:253-260 checks exactly those six. The PR description's "Seven destinations, as in the design… Email is its own card" does not match the code. The description is what is wrong, not this file.

### Summary

**Batch 1 of 2.** Part 1 covers the detail page's new layout, the DestinationsPanel that replaces the \"Where is this going?\" strip, and the reworked MasterCopiesPanel. The wiring is sound: every card, button and banner goes through the same `openPrepare` → `preparePath` navigation. The heavy-banner logic moves from `!master` to `!showDestinations`, which matches the new design. A copy's picture size comes from `resolveExportTarget`, and framing doesn't change a canvas preset's width or height, so leaving it out is safe. None of the removed i18n keys or the deleted strip are referenced anywhere else. I found three things worth a look, all at \"consider\": (1) the new Drag handle skips the `markCopySeen` call that the ready card makes before the same `startFileDrag`, so the Library rail badge can keep counting a copy that was already dragged out; (2) when the file probe fails, the destination cards stay on \"…\" for good, because the panel gets only `probe` and not its status; (3) the \"Open in Export → shows only where…\" test never checks the case where the button is absent. One more point, outside the code: the PR body says there are seven destinations with Email as its own card, but `DESTINATION_IDS` lists six, and Email is still part of the chat card (\"Slack · Discord · Email\"). The panel and its tests match the code, not the description.

**Batch 2 of 2.** I found nothing to fix in this part (tests, stylesheets, backlog docs, en/es messages). The tests check the new title row, the six destination cards and their `?to=` links, the size colours, \"Not now\", the saved notice and the copies panel. None of the removed `library.*` keys is still used anywhere under `apps/`. The stylesheets match the class names the components use. The backlog doc gets the destination count right (six, from `DESTINATION_IDS`); the PR body's \"seven destinations\" does not. One non-blocking suggestion: add a page test for a master whose only copy is still exporting. One contract is still open: I didn't read `probe-source.ts`, so I don't know whether a failed file read leaves the destination cards stuck on \"…\".

<details><summary>What the change connects to (10 closed, 1 open)</summary>

Questions the reviewer answered about what this change does to the running product. The engine checked that the cited lines exist, not that the answers are true.

**Open: the reviewer could not close these**
- Read the file (probe) for every local recording, to get its resolution, the card estimates and each copy's picture size (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/library-detail/library-detail-page.tsx:142`) — Does probeSource ever reject, or does it always resolve null on failure? If it rejects, useSourceProbe's `.then` without a catch leaves the state at `loading` and produces an unhandled rejection. Files that would answer it: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/video-editor/export/probe-source.ts`.

**Closed, with the lines they rest on**
- Clicking a card in the "Where is it going?" DestinationsPanel opens Prepare on that destination (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/library-detail/library-detail-page.tsx:493`) — The router navigates to the Prepare route with the destination preselected. If it fails: This is synchronous navigation, with nothing async to fail. Coming back remounts the page and resets destinationsDismissedFor, so the panel shows again while the recording still has no copies, as the… Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/library-detail/library-detail-page.tsx:149-151`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/library-detail/library-detail-page.tsx:384-387`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/library-detail/library-detail-page.tsx:139`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/library-detail/library-detail-page.tsx:190-191`.
- DestinationsPanel works out each destination's size estimate with planCopy and presetForDestination (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/components/destinations-panel.tsx:41-56`) — Each card's size reads "about / up to N MB", shown amber for send-more destinations and teal otherwise. If it fails: When the probe is null (loading, or an error), the cards show "…". If the probe fails, the cards stay on "…" for good (reported as a finding). Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/destinations.ts:179-190`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/video-editor/export/export-presets.ts:478-504`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/use-prepare-copy.ts:51-58`.
- The Drag handle on a ready copy starts a native file drag through IPC (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/components/master-copies-panel.tsx:171-175`) — The file lands in the target app under the copy's title. The Library rail badge isn't cleared for that copy. If it fails: startFileDrag is a void fire-and-forget call on the existing preload API, and the contextBridge surface doesn't change. If main fails to start the drag, nothing visible happens. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/status-cards/export-status-cards.tsx:231-235`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/video-editor/export/ready-copies.ts:54-58`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/shared/types/electron-api.ts:254-259`.
- The page now probes the file of every local recording, not only heavy ones or those with the card (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/library-detail/library-detail-page.tsx:142`) — The resolution appears in the meta line, plus the destination estimates and the copies' picture sizes. If it fails: If the probe rejects or returns an unusable result, the state becomes error with probe null. The meta line leaves out the resolution and the copy rows show only the file size, both safely. Destinatio… Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/use-prepare-copy.ts:42-67`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/library-detail/library-detail-page.tsx:282-289`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/components/master-copies-panel.tsx:104-114`.
- A "Saved to your Library" notice appears on a fresh recording and closes with ✕ (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/library-detail/library-detail-page.tsx:136-137`) — A green status line above the player. After ✕, the master note shows under the metadata. If it fails: The dismissal is component state, so a remount under the same history entry (router Back) shows the notice again. The existing post-recording card has the same behavior. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/library-detail/library-detail-page.tsx:128-133`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/library-detail/library-detail-page.tsx:341-346`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/library-detail/library-detail-page.tsx:394-412`.
- "Open in Export →" in Copies from this original (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/library-detail/library-detail-page.tsx:513`) — It navigates to Prepare with nothing preselected. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/library-detail/library-detail-page.tsx:436-441`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/components/master-copies-panel.tsx:122-126`.
- Click a destination card in "Where is it going?" to open Prepare on that destination (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/library-detail/library-detail-page.tsx:493`) — The router goes to /prepare/:assetId?to=<id>; the test checks all six ids. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/library-detail/library-detail-page.tsx:149-151`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/components/destinations-panel.tsx:73-82`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/destinations.ts:36-43`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/library-detail/library-detail-page.test.tsx:253-266`.
- "Not now" hides the destinations panel and shows "Export a copy" (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/library-detail/library-detail-page.tsx:494`) — The panel unmounts; the primary "Export a copy" button shows among the actions and opens Prepare without `?to=`. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/library-detail/library-detail-page.tsx:138-139`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/library-detail/library-detail-page.tsx:190-191`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/library-detail/library-detail-page.tsx:436-441`, `apps/documentation/src/content/docs/backlog/prepare-screen.md:101-102`.
- Saved-to-Library notice shown when the page opens from a fresh recording, until dismissed with ✕ (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/library-detail/library-detail-page.tsx:137`) — A green role=status notice above the player; the masterNote line waits until the notice is dismissed. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/library-detail/library-detail-page.tsx:101`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/library-detail/library-detail-page.tsx:129-137`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/library-detail/library-detail-page.tsx:341-346`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/library-detail/library-detail-page.tsx:394-412`.
- Drag handle on a copy row starts a native file drag (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/components/master-copies-panel.tsx:171`) — The OS drags the real file; preventDefault stops the browser's own drag. If it fails: startFileDrag returns nothing to the renderer, so if main refuses the id, no drag starts and nothing is shown. That is the same behaviour as the existing caller. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/components/master-copies-panel.tsx:164-180`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/status-cards/export-status-cards.tsx:1`.
